name: Fujisaki Shiori
source: The player's childhood friend. Once you two were really good friends, but you seemed to have drifted apart. Both intelligent and beautiful, Shiori is one of the most popular girls in her school. To win her heart, the player needs very good stats all-around, as well as get into a first-class university. She is never seen without her trademark yellow headband. Shiori is one of the first three phone numbers the player obtains early in the game.
